title: Olive Gets Help
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4 continues (Learning), 67-sound stage (sl, sm, sn, sp just added).

pages.text: Olive spots a big flat rock.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl standing beside a large flat rock half sunk in the compost heap.

pages.text: Olive can not get it up.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl pushing hard against the rock, unable to move it.
Olive the owl waving to Moss the hedgehog, calling him over.

pages.text: Moss and Olive tug and tug.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog and Olive the owl both pulling hard at the rock together.
The large flat rock staying firmly stuck despite their efforts.
Olive the owl waving to Nell the bee, calling her over to help.

pages.text: Moss, Olive and Nell tug the rock.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog, Olive the owl and Nell the bee all pulling at the rock together.
The large flat rock finally coming free, tipping up out of the ground.
Moss the hedgehog, Olive the owl and Nell the bee grinning together beside the freed rock.
